u0: No non-exit move has yet been completed while holding the box. Your next objective is to pick up the box, if available, and keep it in your hands through at least one non-exit step to advance to u1. If the box is lost or unavailable, you can still head for the exit, but no carrying credit has been earned; reaching the exit now terminates the episode, with a better terminal outcome if the box is in your hands.
u1: You have completed one non-exit move while holding the box. Your next objective is to hold the box on another non-exit move, not necessarily consecutive, to advance to u2. If the box falls or is dropped, progress is not lost: pick it up again and continue carrying it. Reaching the exit now also terminates successfully, with a larger terminal reward if the box is held than if it is not.
u2: You have already held the box on at least two different non-exit moves, so the carrying target is satisfied. Your only remaining objective is to reach the exit. Box possession no longer affects progress: if the box falls or is dropped, it need not be recovered, and reaching the exit terminates the episode successfully whether or not you are still carrying it.
uF: Terminal absorbing success state: you have reached the exit and the episode is over. There is no further movement or box-handling objective; stop taking actions and do not plan further progress.
